title: Derived unit and Leray composition
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ and $g:Z\to Y$ be morphisms of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $K\in D(\mathcal A_X)$, where $\mathcal A_X$ is the category of abelian etale sheaves on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Write $U_h=D(h^{-1})$ for the derived inverse-image functor [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization], and $T_h(K)=\lambda_{h,U_h(K)}\circ R\Gamma(\eta_{h,K})$, where $\eta_h$ is the derived adjunction unit and $\lambda_h$ is the canonical Leray comparison [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Let $C:U_{f\circ g}\simeq U_g\circ U_f$ be the localization of the inverse-image composition isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition], followed by the exact-functor composition comparison. Then $R\Gamma_Z(C_K)\circ T_{f\circ g}(K)=T_g(U_f(K))\circ T_f(K)$. This is an equality of derived morphisms, without an auxiliary complex morphism or a homology degree; $K$ need not be bounded below.

source.place: Lemma Tag 015M (lemma-compose-derived-functors), with the canonical comparison construction of lemma-compose-derived-functors-general; sites.tex Lemma Tag 03CB (lemma-composition-morphisms-sites). Categorical elaboration of the corresponding step of the parent node. The unbounded extension uses K-injective representatives and the general comparison of Tag 05T2; Tag 015M itself states the bounded-below result.

proof.text: Apply Mathlib unit_conjugateEquiv to the composite derived adjunction and the derived adjunction of g ≫ f, and expand rightDerivedLowerStarComp. The inverse/hom conjugate equation gives eta_(g≫f),K followed by R_(g≫f)(C_K) = eta_f,K followed by R_f(eta_g,U_f(K)) followed by D_(U_g(U_f(K))). This is the proved private lemma derivedUnit_comp.
Apply derivedLeray_comp at M=U_g(U_f(K)) to identify RGamma_X(D_M) followed by lambda_(g≫f),M with lambda_f,R_g(M) followed by lambda_g,M.

Naturality of lambda_(g≫f) at C_K moves RGamma_Z(C_K) to R_(g≫f)(C_K). Apply RGamma_X to the unit equality, expand functoriality of composition, substitute the preceding Leray equality, and then use naturality of lambda_f at eta_g,U_f(K). Associativity finishes the displayed equality.

theorem derivedUnitLeray_comp {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) :
    (rightDerivedGlobalSections AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X).map
      ((mapDerivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (g ≫ f)).unit.app K) ≫
    (rightDerivedLowerStarCompRightDerivedGlobalSectionsIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (g ≫ f)).hom.app
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (g ≫ f)).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ≫
    (rightDerivedGlobalSections AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} Z).map
      ((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g f) ≪≫
        Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f)
          (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g)).hom.app K) =
    (rightDerivedGlobalSections AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X).map
      ((mapDerivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).unit.app K) ≫
    (rightDerivedLowerStarCompRightDerivedGlobalSectionsIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).hom.app
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ≫
    (rightDerivedGlobalSections AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} Y).map
      ((mapDerivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).unit.app
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)) ≫
    (rightDerivedLowerStarCompRightDerivedGlobalSectionsIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).hom.app
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).mapDerivedCategory.obj K))
